reason: After the patch, Admin::GroupsController#create and #update (app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb:22-47) read only the top-level params[:name], params[:visible] and params[:alias_level]. Nothing reads params[:group] or sets group.usernames, so an API client that sends group[usernames] gets a success response but membership doesn't change; members can now only be changed through the new add_members and remove_member actions (lines 49-80).
